title: Discourse Signposts & Transitions: Mindenekelőtt & Ami a ... illeti

sections.title: Structuring Signposts
sections.content: Structuring paragraphs requires explicit signposts: *mindenekelőtt* (first and foremost), *másfelől* (on the other hand), *ami a [tárgyat] illeti* (as far as [subject] is concerned).

items.spanish: Mindenekelőtt tisztáznunk kell a legalapvetőbb fogalmakat.
items.english: First and foremost, we must clarify the most fundamental concepts.

items.spanish: Ami a költségvetést illeti, minden részletet pontosan kiszámoltunk.
items.english: As far as the budget is concerned, we calculated every detail precisely.

items.spanish: Másfelől figyelembe kell vennünk a lakosság véleményét is.
items.english: On the other hand, we must also take the opinion of the public into account.
